scenarios.title: Valid CAN Frame with matching PDU size
scenarios.description: A CANFrame declares a DLC of 8 bytes and references a StandardPDU whose payload is also 8 bytes.
scenarios.expected_result: Model validation succeeds with no errors.

scenarios.title: CAN Frame DLC smaller than referenced PDU
scenarios.description: A CANFrame declares DLC=4 but its referenced StandardPDU has an 8-byte payload.
scenarios.injected_fault: size mismatch between Frame and PDU
scenarios.expected_result: Validation fails with a size-mismatch error.

scenarios.title: CAN FD Frame at maximum 64-byte payload
scenarios.description: A CANFDFrame is configured with the maximum allowed payload of 64 bytes.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds at 64 bytes; 65 bytes must fail.

scenarios.title: Client subscribes to an offered Eventgroup
scenarios.description: A SOMEIPServiceConsumer sends Subscribe after receiving a matching Offer via SD, for an Eventgroup declared on the provider.
scenarios.expected_result: SubscribeAck is generated and event Notifications become valid.

scenarios.title: Subscribe to a non-existent Eventgroup
scenarios.description: A SOMEIPServiceConsumer references an Eventgroup ID that is not declared on the provider's service interface.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation fails: consumer references an undefined Eventgroup.

scenarios.title: MACsec channel without a matching key on the peer port
scenarios.description: A MACsecConfig with IntegrityWithConfidentiality is applied to one port, but the connected peer port has no MACsec configuration.
scenarios.injected_fault: asymmetric MACsec configuration across a link
scenarios.!expected_result: Validation fails: MACsec requires matching configuration on both ends of the link.

scenarios.title: Firewall rule at maximum rule count
scenarios.description: A Firewall config is populated with the maximum number of FirewallRule entries supported.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds at the limit; one additional rule must fail.

scenarios.title: CAN Frame forwarded to an unreachable Ethernet socket
scenarios.description: A CANFrameForwarder redirects a Frame to an EthSocketEgress whose destination IP is on a VLAN not reachable from the source ECU.
scenarios.injected_fault: unreachable egress socket across VLAN boundary
scenarios.expected_result: System-level validation fails on forwarder reachability check.
